description: This file handles various server-side node events in a gateway system, including voice transcripts, agent requests, notifications, chat subscriptions, execution events, and push notifications. It defines functions for processing event payloads, managing session state, and interacting with external services.

methods.name: normalizeNonEmptyString
methods.description: Trims and validates that the input is a non-empty string, returning null otherwise.

methods.name: normalizeFiniteInteger
methods.description: Converts a number to an integer if finite, otherwise returns null.

methods.name: resolveVoiceTranscriptFingerprint
methods.description: Generates a fingerprint string for voice transcripts based on available identifiers and timestamp.

methods.name: shouldDropDuplicateVoiceTranscript
methods.description: Determines if a voice transcript is a duplicate within a deduplication window.

methods.name: compactExecEventOutput
methods.description: Normalizes and truncates execution event output text for logging.

methods.name: compactNotificationEventText
methods.description: Normalizes and truncates notification event text for logging.

methods.name: touchSessionStore
methods.description: Updates session store with current session data and timestamp.

methods.name: queueSessionStoreTouch
methods.description: Queues an asynchronous update to the session store, with error logging.

methods.name: parseSessionKeyFromPayloadJSON
methods.description: Parses session key from JSON payload string.

methods.name: parsePayloadObject
methods.description: Parses JSON payload string into an object, or returns null on failure.

methods.name: sendReceiptAck
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment receipt for a message via outbound payloads.
